title: Terminal-cell-width-aware truncation for titles, prompts, crash reasons, and paths
source: exploration plan §3: titles truncated at 54 characters not cells; paths have another fixed limit
why_chosen: Correctness fix: emoji, CJK, combining marks take different cell widths, so char-count truncation often clips too early or too late. Addressed before compact-row work so the new rows start with correct truncation.
before: Titles truncated at 54 characters, prompts at 72 characters, paths at 28 characters (tail suffix, char-based). Emoji and CJK could overflow or be over-truncated.
after: Added `truncate_to_display_width()` using `unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr/Char`. Titles capped at 54 cells, prompts at 72 cells, crash reasons at 54 cells, paths at 30 cells (tail-preserving suffix truncation with display-width budget). All truncation now respects actual terminal column footprint.
evidence: All 95 existing session_picker tests pass. Compilation succeeds cleanly (only pre-existing warnings in jcode-app-core).
